messages:
marco: PineLabs go-live tomorrow 11:00 PST. onboarding checklist mostly done but NPS trend slipped to 6 after demo. plan: prefill key flows, small warm pool, quick in-app pulse at 48h. want minimal risk with import+chat spikes.

jules: What are their peak patterns?

marco: import sends ~150 r/s to /batch/generate for 15m at avg seq=220. chat bursts to 70 r/s for short windows.

nim: runbook suggestion: 1) prefill routes /batch/generate + /chat with prefill_size=250 and prefill_rate=60 to avoid origin overload, 2) warm_workers=5 from -10m to +30m around import, 3) batch.window_ms=45 with jitter=0.12, max_batch_tokens=1200.

tanya: streaming-first on chat so users see tokens quickly; enable partial_streaming=true as fallback. add per-client throttles if queue_depth>70%.

jules: paste warmup curl so ops can schedule.

marco: here you go:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/warmup
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RID"
  -d '{"tenant":"pinelabs","routes":["/batch/generate","/chat"],"prefill_size":250,"prefill_rate":60}'
```

ops-bot: Warmup job created: id=wm-2025-11-02-pl-01 run_at=1831235400

nim: observability items: prefill.started/completed, cache.hit_rate, batch.p50/95/99, stream.first_byte_ms, fallback.count. Tag tenant:renewal_risk=medium & survey_context=go_live_import.

tanya: alert rule: if p99>1200ms OR error_rate>3% for 3m -> route to quantized_small + enable streaming_partial and notify cs-channel. include runbook link.

jules: i'll run prefill and monitor. assign follow-ups: @tanya implement pulse (48h), @nim add metrics, @marco handle renewal outreach if NPS doesn't improve.

ops-bot: Warmup job completed: id=wm-2025-11-02-pl-01 status=success duration=20s prefilled=248 routes=2

marco: metrics look stable so far. leaving warm pool live for 25m. will update Confluence with any edge cases.
